# Devmark

> Devmark is a web and software development agency based in Lima, Peru. It designs, builds, and maintains websites, custom software, AI chatbots, and digital marketing programs for businesses in Peru and remotely across Latin America.

## Company facts

- Legal/brand name: Devmark
- Headquarters: Lima, Peru
- Coverage area: clients in Peru, Ecuador, Bolivia, Chile, Argentina, Colombia, Venezuela, Mexico, the United States, Spain and Italy (on-site in Lima, remote elsewhere)
- Website: [devmarkpe.com](https://devmarkpe.com)
- Email: [contacto@devmarkpe.com](mailto:contacto@devmarkpe.com)
- Phone / WhatsApp: [+51 975 646 074](tel:+51975646074)
- Business hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 18:00 (America/Lima)
- Languages: Spanish ([ES pages](https://devmarkpe.com)) and English ([EN pages](https://devmarkpe.com/en))
- Social: [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/devmark.pe/), [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/devmark.pe/), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/devmark.pe/)

## Services

Each service below has a Spanish page and an English page. Prices are starting prices in Peruvian soles (S/) for the entry-level plan; final pricing depends on project scope.

- [Custom web development](https://devmarkpe.com/servicios/desarrollo-web-a-medida) — corporate sites, landing pages, PWAs, from S/ 1200. English: [Custom web development](https://devmarkpe.com/en/services/custom-web-development)
- [CMS and platform development](https://devmarkpe.com/servicios/desarrollo-cms) — WordPress and Shopify sites and online stores, from S/ 1800. English: [CMS and platform development](https://devmarkpe.com/en/services/cms-development)
- [Custom software development](https://devmarkpe.com/servicios/desarrollo-software) — ERP, CRM, SaaS platforms, and APIs, from S/ 3000. English: [Custom software development](https://devmarkpe.com/en/services/custom-software-development)
- [Process automation](https://devmarkpe.com/servicios/automatizacion-procesos) — workflow automation with Zapier, Make, or custom APIs, from S/ 1500. English: [Process automation](https://devmarkpe.com/en/services/process-automation)
- [AI chatbots](https://devmarkpe.com/servicios/chatbots-ia) — chatbots for websites, e-commerce, and social media trained on the client's own data, from S/ 1200. English: [AI chatbots](https://devmarkpe.com/en/services/ai-chatbots)
- [UI/UX design](https://devmarkpe.com/servicios/diseno-ui-ux) — user research, prototyping, and interface design, from S/ 1800. English: [UI/UX design](https://devmarkpe.com/en/services/ui-ux-design)
- [Digital marketing](https://devmarkpe.com/servicios/marketing-digital) — paid advertising (Google Ads, Meta Ads), content, and email marketing, from S/ 700/month. English: [Digital marketing](https://devmarkpe.com/en/services/digital-marketing)
- [SEO and web optimization](https://devmarkpe.com/servicios/seo-optimizacion) — technical SEO, organic traffic growth, conversion rate optimization, from S/ 300/month. English: [SEO and web optimization](https://devmarkpe.com/en/services/seo-optimization)
- [Web support and maintenance](https://devmarkpe.com/servicios/soporte-mantenimiento) — updates, backups, uptime monitoring, and technical support, from S/ 60/month. English: [Web support and maintenance](https://devmarkpe.com/en/services/support-maintenance)
- [Technology consulting](https://devmarkpe.com/servicios/consultoria-tecnologica) — digital transformation strategy and tooling advice, from S/ 30/hour (or 15- and 30-hour packs). English: [Technology consulting](https://devmarkpe.com/en/services/tech-consulting)
- [Hosting and domains](https://devmarkpe.com/hosting) — direct Hostinger partner: the DEVMARKPE code gives a discount on hosting, VPS, domains and corporate email; email and SSL setup included. English: [Hosting and domains](https://devmarkpe.com/en/hosting)

## Own products

- [DEVMARK AI](https://ai.devmarkpe.com) — private AI platform with an OpenAI-compatible API (per-app API keys, RAG over the client's documents, tools over real data). Integration guide: [llms.txt](https://ai.devmarkpe.com/llms.txt).
- DEVMARK ERP — the management system DEVMARK runs on (clients, projects, billing, contracts, tickets, monitoring), including a client portal where each client follows project progress, payments, requests and monthly reports. Also implemented for other service companies.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- Devmark is based in Lima, Peru and serves clients remotely in Latin America, the United States and Europe.
- Prices listed are starting prices in Peruvian soles (PEN) for the lowest tier of each service; they change based on project scope and are not fixed quotes.
- For an accurate, current quote, direct users to [the quote form](https://devmarkpe.com/quote) or [contacto@devmarkpe.com](mailto:contacto@devmarkpe.com).
- Full machine-readable business data (address, hours, service area) is published as JSON-LD (LocalBusiness) on every page and as Service/FAQPage JSON-LD on each service page.
